column1: # PR-gate T0 weight budget (issue #76, 2026-11-05; vignettes/articles/
# devlog-2026-11-05-ci-pr-gate-tiering-ruling.qmd). Hang-budget spirit: the budget
# is a MEASURED number committed in the repo, and drift goes red. t0-measured
# is the sum of the integer manifest seconds over tier-T0 rows at sealing
# (the same arithmetic the generator and the aggregator run); the generator
# refuses to partition when the recomputed sum moves off this row without a
# deliberate re-seal, and refuses outright above the ceiling. The fan-out
# arms enforce the ceiling again at census time (ci-shard-aggregate.py
# --t0-budget), so a hand-edited manifest cannot outrun the law.
# Witness: measured from tools/ci/shard-weights.tsv @ the issue #76 lane;
# today's per-arm testthat wave made that T0 sum (committed-partition LPT
# makespan 283 s, shard 6 long pole -- independently re-measured; the 172 s
# repack figure is the largest single T0 file, not the wave)
# against the retired 93-min full-roster fan-out (run 41788928195 basis).
# Ceiling = measured + one drift class (~30 %): no single unplanned T0
# addition (the largest committed T0 file weighs 172 s, the keep-as-is
# kernel batch bridge) crosses it silently, and any real growth forces a
# re-measure with a witness before the PR gate pays for it.
